item.title: SOCIAL SIGNAL — Morning — September 10, 2026 — Apple Just Made Foldables Mainstream
item.description:
Apple just pushed foldables closer to the mainstream—and that is only one part of what changed today.
In this episode of SOCIAL SIGNAL, we break down the biggest shifts in marketing, AI, tech, media, consumer behavior, and culture, then pull out the signals marketers should actually care about.
Expect clear facts, sharp WTF moments, and practical takeaways on brand strategy, attention, search, social media, positioning, and where consumer behavior may be heading next.
SOCIAL SIGNAL is the daily marketing briefing for people who want to understand what happened, why it matters, and what marketers should do with it.
item.itunes:summary: Apple is pushing foldable devices closer to the mainstream. This SOCIAL SIGNAL Morning Edition breaks down what that shift means for marketing, AI, media, consumer behavior, brand strategy, search, social, and attention.
